newsitem.title: UK: UK's Labour wins key seat of Birmingham Edgbaston.
newsitem.headline: UK's Labour wins key seat of Birmingham Edgbaston.

text.p: Britain's opposition Labour Party has won the key seat of Birmingham Edgbaston, overturning a Tory majority of 5,056.
This represents a swing to Labour of 10 percent, the BBC said.
Birmingham Edgbaston was number 67 on Labour's list of most winnable seats.

This is the first time ever that Labour has won this seat and commentators said it underscored the strength of what is expected to be a landslide victory for Tony Blair's party. The urban seat is largely middle class with 14 percent of voters holding professional jobs.
